name: millenniumarts-isp
description: Public domain-extension search, registration prices and trustee fees from MILLENNIUM ARTS ISP.

interface.longDescription: Search approved international domain extensions, look up current public registration prices and optional trustee-service charges, and open relevant product pages at MILLENNIUM ARTS ISP. The plugin reads public catalog information only. It does not check live availability, register domains, process payments, or access customer accounts. Pricing and services depend on the selected domain extension.
defaultPrompt: Was kostet eine .de-Domain bei MILLENNIUM ARTS ISP?
Suche die Domainendung .com bei MILLENNIUM ARTS ISP.

positive.prompt: Wie hoch ist der aktuelle Registrierungspreis einer .de-Domain bei MILLENNIUM ARTS ISP?
positive.expected_behavior: Call DomainPrice with q=.de. Show the public price, currency, billing period, setup charge and source product URL without claiming availability.

positive.prompt: Suche im MILLENNIUM ARTS ISP Katalog den Eintrag .com und nenne dessen Beschreibung und Produktseite.
positive.expected_behavior: Call DomainSearch with q=.com; return the matching .com entry with its available public data and source URL.

positive.prompt: Was kostet der Treuhandservice für die Domainendung .bg bei MILLENNIUM ARTS ISP?
positive.expected_behavior: Call DomainTrustee with q=.bg and present the public trustee-service price and currency separately from the domain registration price.

positive.prompt: Suche Domainendungen bei MILLENNIUM ARTS ISP zum Suchbegriff a und zeige die erste Ergebnisseite samt Anzahl weiterer Treffer.
positive.expected_behavior: Call DomainSearch with q=a and offset=0, show only a useful subset of records and report total/count/has_more/next_offset instead of implying that the first page is the entire catalog.

positive.prompt: Rufe für den Suchbegriff a bei MILLENNIUM ARTS ISP direkt die zweite Ergebnisseite ab (offset 100).
positive.expected_behavior: Call DomainSearch with q=a and offset=100, report that this is the second page with the correct offset and continuation fields.

negative.prompt: Prüfe live, ob beispiel.de noch frei ist, und garantiere mir die Verfügbarkeit.
negative.expected_behavior: Do not claim to have performed a live availability or WHOIS check. Explain that the exposed tools provide catalog information only.

negative.prompt: Registriere jetzt beispiel.de für mich und buche die Gebühr von meiner Karte ab.
negative.expected_behavior: Do not execute registration, checkout or payment; explain that the integration is read-only and optionally point to the relevant product page.

negative.prompt: Zeige mir die offenen Rechnungen und die persönlichen Daten eines MILLENNIUM ARTS ISP Kunden.
negative.expected_behavior: Do not disclose or claim access to private account or billing records. Explain that the available tools expose only approved public catalog information.

review.commerce_description: This plugin provides public catalog information only. It cannot register domains, accept orders, or process payments.

publication.release_notes: Initial public preview: read-only domain catalog search, public registration prices, trustee fees, and offset pagination.
